description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kawudana, Monaragala D/S Division, Monaragala District - Cad. Map No. 720103 (24/0232)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding title to specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, locations, ownership details, and land characteristics. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership adjudication and registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
